A1.justification: Both complete 11-page PDFs describe the same VA-VAE and LightningDiT study. Their text, equations, six figures and six tables support reliable comparison. Both end with references; neither contains an appendix.

before.justification: v1 reports original ImageNet reconstruction and generation experiments, convergence and scaling studies, and ablations in Sections 4-6.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including quantitative comparisons in Tables 1-6 and convergence, generation and latent-space visualizations.

M1.justification: Sections 3-4 retain the same VA-VAE architecture, marginal cosine and distance-matrix losses, adaptive weighting, and LightningDiT optimizations. No algorithm, objective or inference procedure changes.

E1.justification: Both versions use ImageNet at 256x256 resolution for image reconstruction and class-conditional generation. No dataset, task, domain or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: The tokenizer comparisons and Table 3's autoregressive and diffusion comparator sets remain unchanged, including DiT, SiT, MDT/MDTv2 and REPA. Newly cited SeQ-GAN and Sana are not added to the evaluated comparisons.

E3.justification: The tokenizer dimensions, model sizes, training budgets, evaluation metrics, FID sample counts and sampling settings remain unchanged. Table 2's restored specification labels identify existing experimental groups rather than revised settings.

E4.justification: The cumulative LightningDiT optimization study, foundation-model and loss ablations, convergence/scaling analyses, and latent-uniformity analysis are retained without substantive changes in Tables 1, 4-6 and Figures 4 and 6.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, confidence intervals or significance tests. Point-estimate reporting and Table 6's descriptive latent-distribution statistics remain unchanged.

E6.justification: Numerical results, plotted trends and qualitative examples are unchanged. Table 3 retains gFID 2.11 at 64 epochs and 1.35 at 800 epochs with classifier-free guidance. Table 2 adds labels without adding or changing scores.

T1.justification: Equations 1-5 defining the projection, alignment losses and adaptive weighting are unchanged. No mathematical definitions, assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion retain the same claims about addressing the reconstruction-generation dilemma, accelerating convergence and achieving ImageNet FID 1.35. The contributions' scientific scope is unchanged.

C2.justification: The interpretations connecting latent uniformity to generation, explaining limited benefits for low-dimensional tokenizers, and discussing scalability remain unchanged in Sections 5-6. No substantive limitation or qualification is added.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, training and sampling descriptions, and the code/model access link remain unchanged. Table 2's restored labels repeat tokenizer dimensions already discussed in v1.

R1.justification: v3 adds SeQ-GAN to Section 2.1 and cites Sana in the introduction, replacing DC-AE as the named example there while retaining its citation. These two added works modestly expand the context; the positioning relative to REPA remains unchanged.

P1.justification: v3 adds coauthor Bin Yang and an Independent Researcher affiliation, lightly edits the introduction, and adds a brief related-work sentence. The section structure and most prose remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Table 2's previously blank specification cells now label the groups f16d16, f16d32 and f16d64. The author block and bibliography typography also produce small layout changes. All six figures and six tables are retained.

improvement.justification: v3 fixes a concrete readability problem in Table 2 by explicitly identifying each tokenizer group and modestly expands relevant prior-work coverage. These changes improve clarity and context, while the methods, empirical evidence and principal claims remain unchanged.
